chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
A biting time period will come upon the people; every person will bite upon what is in his hands, and he will forget kindness.
And Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has said: 'And do not neglect kindness between you.'
A group of people will rise up during that time period who will deal harshly with the desperate ones; they are the worst of the creatures.

key_terms.الْفَضْل: Kindness, grace, or benevolence (often referring to generosity or good treatment)
key_terms.زَمَانٌ عَضُوضٌ: A biting or harsh time period characterized by difficulty
key_terms.يَعَضُّ: To bite, metaphorically meaning to hold tightly or be self-absorbed
key_terms.يَنْبَرِي: To rise up or emerge prominently

ai.seo_question: What characterizes the 'biting time' described in Shia hadith regarding social behavior and kindness?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies a time of social fragmentation where individuals cling rigidly to their own possessions, neglecting the virtue of generosity (al-fadl) as commanded in the Quran. This self-absorption leads to a specific class of people who exploit the desperate, a behavior that marks them as the 'worst of creation' in Shia ethical tradition. The hadith serves as a warning against the moral decay of treating human neediness as a commodity for profit rather than an opportunity for charity.
